# @m2c/vendor

> 标签: auction, m2c, payments, sdk, vendor

## 简介

Vendor-side Node/TypeScript SDK for the M2C payment-vendor auction: verify bid requests, sign bid responses, report conversions.

## 官网

- 官网：https://m2cmarkets.com/docs
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/m2cmarkets/m2c-node.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@m2c/vendor
